candidate_identity.display_label: LLM Library Learning Fails: A LEGO-Prover Case Study

audit_subject.paper: Berlot-Attwell, Rudzicz, Si, LLM Library Learning Fails: A LEGO-Prover Case Study

published_claim_scope.direct_use: Retrieved lemmas can be used within a task.
published_claim_scope.direct_reuse: Across the reported GPT-4o, o3-mini and 4o-mini experiments there is essentially no cross-task direct lemma reuse; the one 4o-mini name-reuse event was manually judged to occur in an erroneous step removed before the final verified proof.
published_claim_scope.soft_reuse: Soft-use exists, but soft reuse across tasks falls near zero at moderate/high similarity thresholds while single-task soft use remains materially nonzero.
published_claim_scope.compute_adjusted_performance: Apparent LP gains under equal attempt counts disappear when cost/token-based compute budget is matched to Draft-Sketch-Prove.
published_claim_scope.scope_guard: These results audit LEGO-Prover/miniF2F under the tested models, prompts, verifier and budget accounting. They do not establish that persistent theorem libraries, library learning, or retrieval-augmented proof systems are generally useless.

released: Modified LEGO-Prover code and experiment commands
Pinned Python dependency list plus an explicit later OpenAI package override in README installation steps
Isabelle2022/PISA setup instructions and a packaged PISA jar
Direct-reuse analysis code and its saved textual output
Soft-use/reuse aggregation and plotting code plus precomputed aggregate artifacts
Public raw LEGO-Prover experiment logs on Internet Archive
remaining_replay_dependencies: External Azure/OpenAI model endpoints are not immutable model snapshots.
Full model-generation replay depends on historical hosted-model behavior and service-side details not captured by the repository.
Soft-use raw recomputation additionally requires the AFP 2019 corpus and the downloaded raw logs.
The cost analysis intentionally ignores Ada embedding cost and uses historical API pricing as a proxy for compute.

independent_reconstruction.method: Recomputed paper Tables 2-4 arithmetic from the official released per-run direct_reuse_analysis.txt and token-usage CSVs without executing the paper's tabulation scripts.
independent_reconstruction.material_discrepancy: The official saved direct-reuse output gives o3-mini run denominators 955 + 864 + 986 = 2805, while the paper's Table 3 reports 20/1825 successful attempts. The 20 successes, 75 prompt lemmas, zero verbatim reuse, zero name reuse, and Table 2 direct-use counts still agree, so this denominator mismatch does not alter the no-direct-reuse conclusion but prevents exact table-level replay without author clarification.

soft_reuse_assessment.status: supported by official code/precomputed aggregates and paper, but not fully recomputed from raw logs in this invocation
soft_reuse_assessment.details: The released plot pipeline calculates per-task use/reuse survival from precomputed JSON aggregates; the README provides the raw-recompute scripts and AFP prerequisite. This invocation inspected the pipeline and an aggregate artifact but did not download the full raw archive/AFP and regenerate every curve.
soft_reuse_assessment.scope: Do not promote the soft-reuse result to independent reproduction from this audit alone.

independent_replication_search.search_summary: Fresh searches found the paper, official repository, original LEGO-Prover repository, author page and mirrors, but no third-party matched rerun reproducing the behavioral tables and compute-matched result.
independent_replication_search.interpretation: Absence in this search is not proof none exists.

o_specific_adaptation.note: C481 is used only as external evidence for separating retrieval, same-task use, future-task reuse and counterfactual future-task utility. No O-specific library-admission mechanism was tested here.

supported: Treat retrieval, same-task use, future-task reuse and counterfactual utility as different evidence fields.
Do not infer cross-task reusable value from library size or same-task usage alone.
Compute-matched baselines are necessary when a library mechanism adds substantial generation/evolution work.
not_supported: A universal claim that theorem libraries or library learning cannot work.
The exact magnitude of any effect outside LEGO-Prover/miniF2F and the tested model/runtime setup.
An O-specific admission/demotion policy without separate matched tests.

reopen_conditions: Authors correct or explain the o3-mini Table 3 denominator mismatch.
A protocol-matched independent rerun reproduces or contradicts direct/soft reuse and compute-adjusted performance.
A frozen model/container/service snapshot enables end-to-end generation replay rather than analysis-only replay.
A source-matched raw soft-reuse recomputation materially changes the published curves or thresholds.
exact_next_action: Do not repeat unchanged C481. On the next bootstrap-valid invocation, resolve the then-current exact sealed wave and audit a different source-qualified non-evaluation candidate with runnable official artifacts, raw receipts/configs, exact formulas, or independent reproduction/failure evidence.
